component.name: Red
component.summary: YouTube client with TV mode, no ads

description.p: Red is a YouTube client for the Linux desktop: a native app to watch YouTube without ads, with a smart TV mode, SponsorBlock, media keys, a mini player and a built-in YouTube downloader. Sign in with your Google account and your subscriptions, history and recommendations work as on the website, in a lightweight window instead of a browser tab.
Two ways to watch, one window:

ul.li: Desktop mode: the full YouTube website, signed in, in light, dark or system theme, with picture-in-picture style mini player
TV mode: the YouTube Leanback interface from smart TVs and consoles, full screen, driven by keyboard, mouse or gamepad controller, ideal for a media center, living room PC or handheld
Ad blocker built in: video ads, banners and sponsored feed items are removed before the page renders, and playback is never touched
Tracker blocking, SponsorBlock to skip sponsor segments, intros and reminders, Return YouTube Dislike counts, and a switch to hide Shorts
YouTube video downloader for any video, playlist or channel, as MP4, MKV or WebM up to 4K
YouTube to MP3: save audio only as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV for music
Subtitles, thumbnail, metadata and chapters embedded; sponsor segments cut out on request
Playlists detected from any link, entries picked one by one, a queue with pause, resume and retry
Your YouTube sign-in is reused, so age-restricted videos and anything your account can watch download too
Media keys and MPRIS media controls, a tray icon with play, pause and skip, the screen kept awake while a video plays
Hardware video decoding, native Wayland and X11, notifications when a download finishes, single instance that opens YouTube links from the command line

description.p: Red is a lightweight alternative to the browser tab, to Electron YouTube apps and to a separate downloader. Everything works on any Linux distribution.
YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Red is an independent client and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by YouTube or Google.

description.p: Red 10 is a redesigned Red on Qt 6 and Qt WebEngine.

ul.li: Desktop and TV modes in one window, switchable at any time
Ad and tracker blocking that never touches playback; SponsorBlock; Return YouTube Dislike; Hide Shorts
Downloads: video, audio only or exact streams, playlists and channels, subtitles, thumbnails and chapters embedded, sign-in reused for restricted videos
Media keys, MPRIS, tray controls, mini player, screen kept awake while playing
A new design that follows YouTube's light and dark themes
